name: luismc-transcript-folds
description: Folds long diffs and finished shell commands to one line in the transcript. A diff over a set number of changed lines draws as one dim line with its path, first changed line and +added -removed counts; a finished Bash or PowerShell call draws as one row with its command and outcome, and the files it edited. A band above the prompt holds two buttons (diffs, commands) bound to the chords the person gives the engine actions theme:toggleSyntaxHighlighting (ctrl+x d) and theme:editCustom (ctrl+x f), and the session's tally of files and lines changed. /fold-diffs and /fold-commands flip the same switches. Three settings: foldAbove, marker, compactCounts. The mod writes no files and runs no commands.

foldAbove.title: Fold diffs above this many changed lines
foldAbove.description: A diff with this many changed lines (added plus removed) or fewer is drawn in full; 0 folds every diff.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: Starts every folded diff line. Leave empty for none.

compactCounts.title: Compact counts
compactCounts.description: Put the added and removed counts on the tool call's own row and drop the line under it.
